device.basis: Method-4 streaming decompressor with the XP4 register interface: the X-T20 2.11 section-6 loader resets it through +0 (0xc5d584), waits for +0 to read nonzero and for +0x24 to read 0x10001, and connects interrupt descriptor row 0x12 of 0xed4720 (interrupt 0x81) with handler 0xc5d348 (0xc5d440).
